page.overview:
Who is Calastro and Rulius Mercanaud?

were twin demonic warlocks and the owners of the Mercanaud Coturier in the city of Dol-Makjar.

Calastro and Rulius look like well-dressed older men wearing long, curly wigs (the former's is gold, while the latter's is platinum), which hide crystalline heads inside of which fire seems to be constantly burning. Their eyes don't reflect external light, and they use illusory magic to add that effect in order to look more normal.

The twins seem cordial and polite but are quite merciless in their job, displaying a savage and professional attitude for it. The only true compassion they had was for each other.

The Mercanaud twins started a business in Dol-Makjar at some point after the Shapers' War. Their couturier, however, hid more sinister activities: due to their connection to Ksha'aravi they had deals with House Halovar, eliminating people for them and providing souls (which they took after cutting away their shadows to turn them into fabric) for the office of Lady Zebani; moreover, they also gave the resulting corpses to House Tachonis.
